title: Earth's rarity and galactic pyramids

tellings.quote: Oh, and they told me that there's there's pyramids all over the galaxy. They're evidently um uh power sources and sources of healing rather than tombs.

plain: There are pyramids all over the galaxy, and they are power sources and places of healing, not tombs. That is what Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies objects said to be alien implants in human bodies, says he was told, though in this account he does not say who told him. If true, Egypt's pyramids would belong to a pattern far bigger than Earth.
